name: design-choice-between-ci-run-types-unsettled-planning-stops-for-the person running Athena-ruling
description: A plan faces a design choice that neither the request, the repo nor the defaults settle (such as which CI run event to trust), the planner and critic cannot resolve it in their rounds, and the job stops at the last round until the the person running Athena rules and re-queues it.
